note: Les Mills program descriptions for the FAC schedule tooltips. PUBLISHED FIELD is `summary` (our own words, written by the coding agent) — that is the ONLY text rendered on the site. `source_text` holds the verbatim copy fetched from lesmills.com for REFERENCE ONLY and is never embedded into index.html/data.json. fetch_descriptions.py refreshes `source_text` and flags when it changes so the summary can be rewritten; it never overwrites `summary`. All tooltips credit and link back to Les Mills.

BODYPUMP.name: LES MILLS BODYPUMP
BODYPUMP.summary: Les Mills' original barbell class: light-to-moderate weights and high repetitions work every major muscle group to build lean strength, tone up and burn calories — all set to motivating music.
BODYPUMP.source_text: BODYPUMP is the original barbell workout for strength and toning. Build lean muscle, burn calories, and get stronger with this proven group fitness class.
BODYPUMP.summary_source: BODYPUMP is the original barbell workout for strength and toning. Build lean muscle, burn calories, and get stronger with this proven group fitness class.

BODYATTACK.name: LES MILLS BODYATTACK
BODYATTACK.summary: A high-energy cardio class built on athletic, explosive movement. Sports-style drills mixed with strength moves build all-round fitness, endurance and stamina.
BODYATTACK.source_text: BODYATTACK is a high-energy cardio workout combining athletic training with explosive moves. Build fitness, endurance & stamina. Find a class or try online.
BODYATTACK.summary_source: BODYATTACK is a high-energy cardio workout combining athletic training with explosive moves. Build fitness, endurance & stamina. Find a class or try online.

GRIT.name: LES MILLS GRIT
GRIT.summary: A 30-minute high-intensity interval workout that pushes you hard. Offered in Strength, Cardio and Athletic styles, it builds lean muscle, speed and stamina in a focused, coach-led session.
GRIT.source_text: 30-minute high-intensity interval training that pushes you to the edge. GRIT Strength, Cardio & Athletic workouts build lean muscle, speed & stamina.
GRIT.summary_source: 30-minute high-intensity interval training that pushes you to the edge. GRIT Strength, Cardio & Athletic workouts build lean muscle, speed & stamina.

CORE.name: LES MILLS CORE
CORE.summary: A short (30–45 minute) class that strengthens the muscles around your core — abs, glutes and back. Science-backed exercises build the stability and control that carry over to sport and everyday movement, and help guard against injury. (Formerly CXWORX.)
CORE.source_text: Build core strength with LES MILLS CORE. Science-backed 30/45-min workout targeting abs, glutes & back. Improve stability, speed & injury prevention.
CORE.summary_source: Build core strength with LES MILLS CORE. Science-backed 30/45-min workout targeting abs, glutes & back. Improve stability, speed & injury prevention.

SHAPES.name: LES MILLS SHAPES
SHAPES.summary: A low-impact, high-output full-body class that blends sculpt training, Pilates and power yoga. It builds strength and shape without lifting heavy weights, in 30- or 45-minute formats.
SHAPES.source_text: Low-impact, high-output full-body workout combining sculpt training, Pilates, and power yoga. Build strength without lifting. 30/45 min classes.
SHAPES.summary_source: Low-impact, high-output full-body workout combining sculpt training, Pilates, and power yoga. Build strength without lifting. 30/45 min classes.

STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.name: LES MILLS STRENGTH DEVELOPMENT
STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.summary: A science-backed, progressive resistance-training program done in a group setting. Steadily increasing the load over time builds real muscle and strength.
STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.source_text: Les Mills STRENGTH DEVELOPMENT: Build muscle and increase strength with science-backed progressive resistance training in a group setting.
STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.summary_source: Les Mills STRENGTH DEVELOPMENT: Build muscle and increase strength with science-backed progressive resistance training in a group setting.

TONE.name: LES MILLS TONE
TONE.summary: An all-round, full-body class mixing cardio, strength and core work. It's built to boost athleticism and movement control while helping you get fit and toned — a great everyday option.
TONE.source_text: LES MILLS TONE combines cardio, strength and core in one full-body workout. Boost athleticism, get fit and toned, and improve movement control.
TONE.summary_source: LES MILLS TONE combines cardio, strength and core in one full-body workout. Boost athleticism, get fit and toned, and improve movement control.

CEREMONY.name: LES MILLS CEREMONY
CEREMONY.summary: Les Mills' HYROX-partnership class: high-performance strength and cardio training that moves you through eight functional workout stations. The coach-led, music-driven format builds strength, fitness and stamina, with the group's energy carrying you from one station to the next. (FAC runs it as Ceremony — Hyrox and Ceremony — Stations.)
CEREMONY.source_text: Discover LES MILLS x HYROX, the official group training partnership delivering science-backed functional workouts, race-ready training, and scalable gym solutions.
CEREMONY.summary_source: Discover LES MILLS x HYROX, the official group training partnership delivering science-backed functional workouts, race-ready training, and scalable gym solutions.

RPM.name: LES MILLS RPM
RPM.summary: Les Mills' original indoor cycling class. Ride to the beat through science-backed intervals — low-impact but high-energy — setting your own intensity on the bike.
RPM.source_text: RPM is the original indoor cycling workout. Ride to the rhythm with science-backed cardio training. Low-impact, high-energy. Find a class or try on LES MILLS+.

SPRINT.name: LES MILLS SPRINT
SPRINT.summary: A 30-minute high-intensity interval ride that delivers big results in little time. Science-backed bursts of hard effort and recovery push your limits on the bike.
SPRINT.source_text: 30-minute HIIT cycling workout that maximizes results in minimal time. Science-backed intervals push your limits. Find classes or try on LES MILLS+.
